title: Honey plus coffee versus systemic steroid in the treatment of persistent post-infectious cough: a randomised controlled trial
notes: Most directly on-population source found (adults, post-infectious cough >3 weeks, n=97). Single research group, single centre, Tehran. Related earlier reports by the same group (Iran J Otorhinolaryngol 2011) appear to overlap the same participants - check for double-counting before any pooled statement. Comparator was guaifenesin as 'control', not inert placebo. Risk of bias not assessed in this return.
